claim: P1 engineering evidence for the bounded abstraction cost of a prepared Compute RMSNorm over the same public Mem mapping plus HYLE SIMD route, and of a pre-bound one-node Graph Invocation over that same PreparedOperation, using one normal 4096-element inference row

configuration.role: same-product lower abstraction tier, not an external SOTA peer
configuration.route: the same system Buffer storage is mapped through public Mem and passed to the same hyle::simd::rms_norm_f32 route
configuration.semantic_delta: the direct consumer owns mapping/error plumbing and does not receive Compute tensor, alias or queue validation

configuration.role: same-product immediate lower abstraction tier, not an external SOTA peer
configuration.route: the exact PreparedOperation, Queue, TensorView storage and Completion boundary held by the compiled one-node Graph plan
configuration.semantic_delta: Graph additionally owns immutable plan identity and verifies its fixed binding set

ownership_topology.candidate: One warmed CPU PreparedOperation validates one borrowed input/output TensorView pair, maps the caller-owned system Buffers, invokes the selected HYLE SIMD RMSNorm route and returns an already-terminal Completion
ownership_topology.peer: The same thread directly maps the same caller-owned system Buffers through public Mem, invokes the same HYLE SIMD RMSNorm route and closes both mappings
ownership_topology.equivalence: Arithmetic, 4096-element f32 input, output address, Mem resource, SIMD route, precision, synchronization and process are identical; this is a disclosed abstraction-cost ladder because Compute additionally guarantees descriptor, alias, context and queue validation

material_contribution.denominator: one normal prepared RMSNorm inference row
material_contribution.derivation: A 4096-wide normalization row is a common transformer hidden dimension and keeps the fixed contract tax in its normal consumer denominator

workloads.semantic_contract: Execute one warmed, allocation-free f32 RMSNorm over 4096 elements from caller-owned host Buffer storage, observe all map/close failures and finish at the synchronous completion boundary

input.distribution: deterministic positive f32 values repeated modulo 127

workloads.setup: Context, Queue, descriptions, Buffers, views and PreparedOperation are created and warmed before epochs; both rows overwrite the same output Buffer sequentially
charged_phases: candidate-only fixed tensor/alias/context/queue validation and Completion observation

ownership_topology.candidate: One pre-bound exclusive Graph Invocation verifies its fixed binding mask and submits the PreparedOperation retained by its immutable shared plan
ownership_topology.peer: The exact same PreparedOperation is submitted directly with the same Queue, TensorViews, storage and Completion observation
ownership_topology.equivalence: Both execute the identical prepared artifact and all Compute validation/arithmetic; Graph alone adds the promised plan and binding-completeness semantics, so the result is an explicit composition-tax measurement rather than an unrelated peer claim

material_contribution.derivation: The package Graph journey is the first executable inference slice; compile and bind are correctly excluded from submit-many steady state

workloads.semantic_contract: Submit one pre-bound, allocation-free one-node RMSNorm Graph over a 4096-element f32 row and observe the same synchronous Completion as direct Compute

input.distribution: the exact same deterministic input and output Buffer used by the Compute row

workloads.setup: Graph construction, compile, plan allocation, Invocation creation and both bindings occur before epochs; submit reads no logical Graph and performs no allocation or route search
